thread:
Mia: quick heads-up — vendor-ops reported ~20% post-firmware fail on newly shipped H100 racks in apac-west. We have a customer demo in ~6h. Can we carve temporary capacity elsewhere? PR with context: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4321

Alex: ack, checking cloud quotas now.

Alex: GCP apac-west has 0 free H100 and 1 free A100. apac-south has 2 A100 but adds ~35-45ms tail latency for demo traffic. eu-west has 3 A100s available. Links: https://console.cloud.google.com/compute

Sophie: demo SLO is p50<80ms, p95<200ms. apac-south probably okay for p95 but not p50. EU would push p50 up ~50-70ms for APAC users.

Mia: vendor-bot says firmware 2.1.3 hold, ETA 18h. @vendor-ops can you confirm? :eyes: 

jordan-vendor-bot: vendor-ops: Firmware team paused the H100 rollout due to thermal sensor regressions. Next patch ETA ~18 hours. No additional racks will be provisioned until validated.

Alex: Plan A: borrow 2 A100s in apac-south for demo and set routing to prefer apac-west but failover to apac-south for constrained requests. Plan B: route demo traffic through eu-west canary for 10% of sessions to validate.

Sophie: prefer Plan A if possible, but need a canary with 5% to monitor quality. I'll update routing policy.

Alex: Terraform quick patch (apply only burst pool):
```
module "burst_pool" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/infra//modules/gpu-pool"
  region = "apac-south1"
  count  = 1
  sku    = "a100"
}
```
PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4322

Mia: @oncall please stand by for rollback. If latency >250ms for >2min, auto-switch back to apac-west-only.

oncall: ack. I'll watch traces and have rollback playbook ready. Add a monitoring alert: trace_p95 > 250ms for 2min.

Alex: estimate extra egress/cost ~ $45/hr. I'll tag cost center and start the pool as soon as PR merges.

Sophie: adding a note to demo runbook and emailing the customer about possible region fallback. :email: 

Mia: thanks, team. I'll coordinate with vendor-ops for final timeline and update this thread when firmware clears.
